Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: An expense item representing money spent by a user in a specific category.

amount.description: The amount spent in numeric value

description.description: Context and comments for the charge

user.description: The UID of the user who owns this resource

createdAt.description: Date-time string representing when this expense was logged

updatedAt.description: Date-time string representing when this expense was last revised

Budget.title: Budget
Budget.description: A spending limit on a particular category.

rolloverEnabled.description: Optional flag to carry over budget

user.description: The UID of the user who owns this budget resource

createdAt.description: Date-time string when budget was created

updatedAt.description: Date-time string when budget was last modified
